D/ CONSTANT INVS NOB C ; R/ GLOR IAEXERC [ITVS]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust rosette diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANT INVS NOB C. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEXERC [ITVS]. In exergue: probably TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this…
